events.evidence: Reuters reports that the Treasury of the Republic of Italy is working on the terms of a bailout for the third-largest lender in the country, Monte dei Paschi
JPMorgan announces it plans to cut 17,000 jobs over the next two years, primarily from the company's mortgage unit
Taliban insurgents kill 17 Afghan government-affiliated militia personnel in an overnight attack in Andar District of eastern Ghazni Province

label.note: Italian bank bailout and US bank job cuts offset by no broad market shock.
